population.join: Match query_id and exact ten raw coefficients in the two authorized development archives. Use the original ordered raw tangent columns.

base.source: Independent motion and primal entries must agree bitwise on target-frame vertices, indexed triangles, cap bits and operated side. Audit the actual transformed binary64 physical operand.
base.physics: Use the versioned typed teacher, actual full registered design, Cherchi, oriented retained boundary and native rational material integration. Record old-context full and typed rejections separately.
base.audit: Calculate all ten editable and fixed-plus-editable signed-tetrahedron moments. Differentiate those tetrahedra using the post-Boolean retained-vertex motion in each raw chart column.

central_difference.path: Use the full signed raw step along each original basis column. Keep a zero quadratic block for planes. For paraboloids keep the center signed near-zero eigenvalue fixed by subtracting the change of the smallest-absolute eigenvalue times its spectral projector. Explicitly return the original bits at h=0. A binary64 center can have a tiny nonzero determinant; report its spectrum, tangent residual and measured central-path error.
central_difference.denominator: 2h on the raw tangent. No coefficient renormalization or change to the units of h is applied by the harness.
central_difference.source: Check each side using the separate native value-only source. Compare source index connectivity, cap mask, selected side and vertex count to the moving center. Compare every source vertex against the center raw velocity using both signs.
central_difference.retained: Recompute each physical Boolean using the two actual geometry operands. Compare signed retained ten-moment differences, and compare all uniquely corresponding retained-vertex velocities using exact construction support identities. Discretization changes and rejected sides remain in the ledger. Integration of the same perturbed Cherchi boundary can use a verified fast-value path.
central_difference.acceptance_formula: ||estimate-reference||_2 <= atol + rtol * max(||estimate||_2, ||reference||_2); report relative, absolute maximum, and norm errors for each raw column separately.
central_difference.column_support: The material FD comparison is reported whenever both cut moments and center J exist. Stable source topology requires exact equality of side, cap mask and indexed source faces. Record retained construction-set equality, oriented or unordered canonical triangle incidence, matched counts and retained-velocity errors separately. A verified sampled column requires complete stable retained construction correspondence/topology and all three checks.
central_difference.failure: Retain every source/physical/derivative rejection and exact diagnostic. Missing values and masks are explicit, and successes on a subset never count as a full-row finite-difference pass.

event_status: ambient_event_valid = restricted_event_valid = -1. Numerical observations at finitely many settings do not certify a neighbourhood.
scope: New versioned algebraic source only for the primary replay. An archived diagnostic on a different source map and manufactured examples are controls only. No blind-case files, labels, fitting, or model training.
